Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: FinOptics is primarily focused on cutting inference latency at peak loads, reducing per-token cost across bursty batch patterns, and getting an on-prem/Private deployment path that satisfies your audit controls for customer data. The engineering notes we captured: 8–12k tokens/session at 200–300 concurrent sessions during nightly batch windows; SOC‑2 evidence and fine-grained audit logs are gating for procurement.

To keep momentum I'd like to propose two immediate next steps to unblock a pilot:

- Executive alignment: 30m VP/CTO handshake so your CTO can validate architecture constraints and we can align on trial acceptance criteria.
- Technical deep-dive/demo: 45–60m run-through (infra + model selection + KV/prefix caching tradeoffs) with our infra lead so we can size Dedicated vs Private.

Proposed windows (all PST):
1) Tue Nov 23 — 11:00–11:45
2) Thu Nov 25 — 09:00–10:00
3) Mon Nov 29 — 10:00–11:00

Can you confirm who from your side would join the exec handshake (CTO + VP Product are ideal), and which slot looks best? I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a high-level SOW draft to speed approvals.

Attachments: RWI_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf)

If you prefer, I can send a tentative calendar invite and mark it as tentative until we confirm attendees.

Best,
Kimberly Park
